meta.title: Javi · A life in milestones
meta.description: Javi's life from 1980 to today as a sky of memories, with a book for his children and the Echo to keep talking with him. Join a waitlist.

guide.title: How to read this sky

guide.ring: A hollow ring is still ahead: the book and the Echo
guide.dust: The fine dust is the days, thicker where more happened

hero.title: A life, in milestones.
hero.lede: I'm Javi. This is my life from 1980 to today: a cloud of dots per memory, a galaxy per age. Explore it as you like. Ahead: a book for my children, and the Echo, my voice for those who want to keep talking with me.

early.name: Early years
early.title: Early years.
early.intro: I was born in Bilbao in April 1980 and spent my first years between a farmhouse with cows and a fifth floor with no lift. A brother arrived, school began, and a courtyard a few metres from home was the whole world. Most of what came later started in these small rooms.
early.hint: A farmhouse, a courtyard, a brother

school.name: School years
school.title: School years.
school.intro: At eight the house broke one night, and the family I knew changed shape. I spent a season with my grandparents in Galicia, learned a sport on a mat, tore a muscle and broke my front teeth. These were the years I learned that things end, and that a body heals.
school.hint: A house that broke, a body that healed

youth.name: Youth
youth.title: Youth.
youth.intro: I failed a year out of rebellion and paid for my first laptop myself. Between an old programming language and JavaScript I found a trade that asked nobody's permission. Then came a first payslip and, after it, a first breakup.
youth.hint: A laptop, a trade, a first payslip

building.name: Building a life
building.title: Building a life.
building.intro: I worked for others and then built my own: a t-shirt brand that came out of the snow, a company I sold from the other side of the world. I left with one backpack and stayed far from where I started. There a friend and a film introduced me to Yuri, and we married with two witnesses.

midlife.name: Midlife
midlife.title: Midlife.
midlife.intro: At forty I became a father, built a house and watched the water take it. My grandfather went, my son and I put on white belts, and I began writing my life down. Now I am gathering the papers to go back.
midlife.hint: A son, a flood, the way back

book.hint: Everything I learned, written down for my children. Not out yet.
book.title: A book for my children.
book.body: It's for my children, and for anyone who wants it: my life, what I've learnt, what went well and what went wrong. Leave your email and I'll write to you when it's out.
